The following bereavement guide has been prepared for the convenience of British nationals who may require these services and assistance in Uruguay.

Includes information on:

what to do when someone dies in Uruguay

burial and cremation

returning bodies to the UK (repatriation)

See also what to do when someone dies: death abroad.
